text: Done. Every step card in "What actually happens, in order" now has a photo that matches its words: 1, a team member taking a call at the front desk (booking); 2, the building (arriving at suite 104B); 3, Dr. Nguyen with a young patient; 4, the hygienist with the screen on the wall (the cleaning and the look around); 5, a team member going over a plan on a tablet with a parent (the plan and the price); 6, two kids with their Anti-Cavity Club prizes (giving back). The photos are a little taller now, and each one is positioned so faces are not cut off, including Dr. Nguyen's in step 3. The last card, the new patient special, stays as the booking card without a photo. It is on staging now; please hard-refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R) to see it.
